metadata.description: Wismer Park (Markham, ON): official City of Markham park polygons plus OpenStreetMap features that touch them.

sources.City of Markham: City of Markham Parks dataset (Assets/WismerParks.geojson). Treated as authoritative for boundaries.
sources.OpenStreetMap: Overpass API, OSM base 2026-11-15T15:31:38Z. © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Community-mapped; not verified against an official site map.
sources.streets: OpenFreeMap vector tiles (OpenMapTiles schema, transportation_name layer), © OpenStreetMap contributors. Extracted because the Overpass API was unavailable.

properties.derivation: Dissolved from the Park, Woodlot and Valley polygons (unshared edges only).
